data_description.vehicle_1_battery_capacity_kwh: Usable battery capacity used by Intelligent charging until it has learned the energy per percent from real charges. 0 = automatic: the Volvo battery-capacity sensor next to the battery sensor, else 75 kWh.
data_description.vehicle_2_battery_capacity_kwh: Usable battery capacity used by Intelligent charging until it has learned the energy per percent from real charges. 0 = automatic: the Volvo battery-capacity sensor next to the battery sensor, else 75 kWh.
data_description.notify_on_schedule_window: Keep a persistent notice when a charging window starts with Charge with schedule disabled. Also enables optional notification delivery below.
data_description.schedule_notification_service: Leave empty for persistent notices only. Use notify.notify, notify.mobile_app_your_phone, or notify.send_message. Reminders follow the selected schedule helper, including schedule edits and local daylight-saving changes.
data_description.schedule_notification_targets: For notify.send_message, add one or more notify entity IDs. For legacy notify actions, use provider-specific target IDs if needed; a mobile-app-specific action usually needs none.
data_description.schedule_reminder_minutes: Send one notification this many minutes before the next window (default 60), plus one while it opens. Zero disables advance delivery. Requires a notification action and Charge with schedule to be off.
